mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) = 1 AND COALESCE(BOOL_AND(child.quantity = #{gross} AND child.currency_id = #{currencyId}), false) FROM transaction child JOIN transaction_event outcome ON outcome.transaction_id = child.transaction_id WHERE child.parent_transaction_id = #{paymentTransactionId} AND child.transaction_type_id = 2 AND outcome.transaction_event_type_id = 5

SELECT child.transaction_id AS "transactionId", child.parent_transaction_id AS "paymentTransactionId", child.reference AS "reference", child.quantity AS "quantity", child.currency_id AS "currencyId", detail.net_quantity AS "netQuantity", detail.tax_quantity AS "taxQuantity", child.created_ts AS "createdTs", outcome.transaction_event_type_id AS "eventTypeId" FROM transaction child JOIN refund_detail detail ON detail.transaction_id = child.transaction_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT transaction_event_type_id FROM transaction_event WHERE transaction_id = child.transaction_id ORDER BY transaction_event_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) outcome ON true WHERE child.parent_transaction_id = #{paymentTransactionId} AND child.transaction_type_id = 3 ORDER BY child.transaction_id

SELECT child.transaction_id AS "transactionId", child.parent_transaction_id AS "paymentTransactionId", child.reference AS "reference", child.quantity AS "quantity", child.currency_id AS "currencyId", detail.net_quantity AS "netQuantity", detail.tax_quantity AS "taxQuantity", child.created_ts AS "createdTs", outcome.transaction_event_type_id AS "eventTypeId" FROM transaction child JOIN refund_detail detail ON detail.transaction_id = child.transaction_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT transaction_event_type_id FROM transaction_event WHERE transaction_id = child.transaction_id ORDER BY transaction_event_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) outcome ON true WHERE child.reference = #{reference} AND child.transaction_type_id = 3

INSERT INTO transaction (transaction_type_id, parent_transaction_id, account_id, reference, quantity, currency_id, created_ts) VALUES (3,#{paymentTransactionId},#{merchantAccountId},#{reference},#{gross},#{currencyId}, #{createdAt}) ON CONFLICT (reference) DO NOTHING RETURNING transaction_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO refund_detail (transaction_id, transaction_type_id, net_quantity, tax_quantity) VALUES (#{transactionId},3,#{net},#{tax})
